step-hebrew.name: STEP Bible: TAHOT, TBESH, TEHMC
step-hebrew.description: Tyndale House / STEP Bible. Hebrew and Aramaic text, segmented tokens, morphology and abridged BDB. Bundled snapshot has no recorded upstream commit. Cantillation and source formatting were simplified by build_interlinear.py.

step-greek.name: STEP Bible: TAGNT, TBESG, TEGMC
step-greek.description: Tyndale House / STEP Bible. Amalgamated Greek text and morphology. TBESG uses corrected Abbott-Smith where available, with supplementary definitions. Bundled snapshot has no recorded upstream commit.

strongs.name: Open Scriptures: Strong's Hebrew and Greek dictionaries
strongs.license: CC-BY-SA (digital edition; version not stated in source header)
strongs.description: Greek JSON copyright 2009 Open Scriptures; Hebrew JSON copyright 2010 Open Scriptures. Greek XML: Ulrik Petersen; Hebrew corrections/transliterations: David Instone-Brewer and David Troidl. Underlying historical Strong works date from 1890/1894. Digital edition carries its own CC-BY-SA notice. Exact license version and the original bundled snapshot must be resolved before release. Source derivations and KJV lists are historical opinions, not independent verse-specific analysis.

editorial.name: Imani za Msingi bilingual study help
editorial.description: AI-assisted editorial drafts prepared against the bundled lexical evidence. No independent Hebrew, Greek or Kiswahili linguistic review is recorded.

en.text: Beginning: the initial part or starting point. This extended entry concerns beginning; related uses such as the best portion are distinguished in the source.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H7225G; compare the separately identified H7225H.

sw.text: Mwanzo: sehemu ya kwanza au mahali jambo linapoanzia. Ingizo hili linahusu mwanzo; matumizi yanayohusu sehemu iliyo bora yametofautishwa katika chanzo.
sw.evidence: TBESH H7225G; H7225H ni ingizo tofauti.

en.text: To create, shape or form. The source distinguishes uses by Hebrew verb stem; the occurrence's morphology and sentence determine which use applies.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H1254A, Qal and Niphal subsections.

sw.text: Kuumba au kufanya kitu kiwepo au kipate umbo. Chanzo hutofautisha matumizi kulingana na muundo wa kitenzi cha Kiebrania; sarufi na sentensi ya aya huongoza maana inayofaa.
sw.evidence: TBESH H1254A, sehemu za Qal na Niphal.

en.text: God. This extended entry identifies the use referring to God. Its plural grammatical form must be considered together with the verb and the surrounding sentence.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H0430G identifies God; the wider Strong family also includes other uses.

sw.text: Mungu. Ingizo hili maalumu linatambua matumizi yanayomhusu Mungu. Umbo lake la kisarufi la wingi linahitaji kusomwa pamoja na kitenzi na sentensi inayolizunguka.
sw.evidence: TBESH H0430G; matumizi mengine yapo katika familia pana ya Strong.

en.text: Heaven, heavens or sky: the visible sky where the stars are seen, and by extension the dwelling place of God. This Hebrew noun has a dual form only; no singular form is in use.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H8064; the noun is grammatically dual, with no attested singular.

sw.text: Mbingu au anga: anga linaloonekana ambapo nyota huonekana, na kwa maana pana, mahali anapokaa Mungu. Nomino hii ya Kiebrania ina umbo la wingi-mbili tu; hakuna umbo la umoja linalotumika.
sw.evidence: TBESH H8064; kisarufi nomino hii ipo katika umbo la wingi-mbili pekee, bila umoja unaotumika.

en.text: Land or earth: the whole earth as against heaven, a specific territory or country, the ground underfoot, or those who live on the land, depending on the passage.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H0776G; the source lists many related senses distinguished by context.

sw.text: Nchi au dunia: dunia yote kwa ujumla ikilinganishwa na mbingu, eneo au nchi fulani, ardhi chini ya miguu, au wakaaji wa nchi hiyo, kulingana na kifungu husika.
sw.evidence: TBESH H0776G; chanzo kinaorodhesha maana nyingine zinazohusiana, zinazotofautishwa kwa muktadha.

en.text: To remember or bring to mind; in some constructions, to remind or mention. The verb form and its object help distinguish these uses.

sw.text: Kukumbuka au kuweka jambo akilini; katika miundo mingine, kukumbusha au kutaja. Umbo la kitenzi na jambo linalohusika husaidia kutofautisha matumizi haya.

en.text: Sabbath. The source includes the Sabbath day and related calendrical uses; the passage identifies the particular observance intended.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESH H7676; uses are listed separately in the source.

sw.text: Sabato. Chanzo kinajumuisha siku ya Sabato na matumizi mengine ya kalenda; kifungu chenyewe hutambulisha maadhimisho yanayokusudiwa.
sw.evidence: TBESH H7676; kila matumizi yameorodheshwa kando katika chanzo.

en.text: A word or expression of thought; also speech, a message, an account or reasoning. The source gives several senses, which must be distinguished by context.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESG and Strong's G3056. This summary does not select a sense for any specific verse.

sw.text: Neno au namna wazo linavyoelezwa; pia usemi, ujumbe, taarifa au hoja. Chanzo kina maana kadhaa ambazo zinahitaji kutofautishwa kwa kuzingatia muktadha.
sw.evidence: TBESG na Strong G3056. Muhtasari huu hauchagui maana kwa aya fulani.

en.text: Love, goodwill or esteem; the source also records the plural use for fellowship meals. The noun alone does not define every kind or expression of love.

sw.text: Upendo, nia njema au heshima kwa mwingine; chanzo pia kinarekodi matumizi ya wingi yanayohusu milo ya ushirika. Nomino hii pekee haielezi kila namna ya upendo.

en.text: Grace, favour or graciousness; also gratitude in appropriate constructions. The relationship between giver and recipient and the surrounding words guide the sense.

sw.text: Neema, fadhili au wema unaoonyeshwa kwa mwingine; pia shukrani katika miundo inayofaa. Uhusiano wa mtoaji na mpokeaji pamoja na maneno yanayolizunguka huongoza maana.

en.text: Sabbath keeping or Sabbath rest. The source records the occurrence in Hebrews 4:9. Its role in the argument needs to be read with the surrounding discussion of rest.
en.evidence: Bundled TBESG G4520; the source cites Hebrews 4:9.

sw.text: Kushika Sabato au pumziko la Sabato. Chanzo kinarekodi matumizi katika Waebrania 4:9. Nafasi yake katika hoja inahitaji kusomwa pamoja na maelezo yanayoizunguka kuhusu pumziko.
